facts.fact: Disrupt Africa reports MNT-Halan raised EGP3.4 billion (US$71.4 million) through its seventh securitised bond issuance, managed by CIB and CI Capital, within an EGP8 billion programme approved by Egypt's Financial Regulatory Authority.
Disrupt Africa reports MNT-Halan's most recent earlier raise was a US$49 million corporate bond issuance in May.
